title: Ge/ZnS Three-Cavity Fabry-Perot Dual-Bandpass with 24 Layers
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 20 to 24 enables three Fabry-Perot cavities instead of two, providing additional degrees of freedom to simultaneously optimize both passbands (4.15-4.35 μm and 4.55-4.75 μm) while maintaining stopband suppression (3.60-4.00 μm and 4.85-5.20 μm).
design_principle: Multi-cavity Fabry-Perot bandpass filter with alternating high/low index quarter-wave stacks forming three resonant cavities, optimized via gradient-based thickness tuning with quarter-wave analytical initialization.
proposed_topology: CaF2 substrate | (Ge/ZnS) periodic Bragg mirrors | 3 cavity spacers | (Ge/ZnS) periodic Bragg mirrors | air, exactly 24 finite layers total
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot cavity resonance condition: 2nd = mλ for constructive interference
Bragg mirror reflectivity increases with layer pair count
Multi-cavity coupling produces squarer passband profiles
expected_advantages: More cavity degrees of freedom for dual-band optimization
Higher stopband suppression with additional mirror pairs
known_risks: Increased total thickness may cause stress issues
More layers increase fabrication tolerance sensitivity
Optimization may converge to local minima
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer dielectric multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate for dual-band infrared transmission. Layer sequence: Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS-Ge-ZnS (24 finite layers, alternating Ge and ZnS starting with Ge). Wavelength bands: passbands at 4150-4350 nm and 4550-4750 nm (maximize transmittance), stopbands at 3600-4000 nm and 4850-5200 nm (minimize transmittance). Normal incidence, unpolarized light, coherent TMM. Initialize all Ge layers at 550 nm and all ZnS layers at 900 nm (quarter-wave at 4.4 μm center). Optimization bounds: Ge [400, 700] nm, ZnS [650, 1150] nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.002, clamp thickness changes to ±15% of nominal values for first 3 epochs, then release full bounds. Maximum 500 optimization iterations. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3600-4000 nm, 4150-4350 nm, 4550-4750 nm, 4850-5200 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 4.15-4.35 um and 4.55-4.75 um bands; low transmittance in 3.60-4.00 um and 4.85-5.20 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance in stopbands; high reflectance in passbands. manufacturing constraints: no metal layers; maximum 24 layers; conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 20 to 24 to enable three-cavity topology, addressing iteration 09's poor performance (0.383 score) by providing more optimization degrees of freedom while retaining quarter-wave initialization principle from feedback directives.
